question: During an algebraic investigation, students use the vectors $\vec{a}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}-\hat{k}$. They compare multiplying a vector difference by a scalar with multiplying the original vectors separately. They also reverse the order of subtraction to study how the resulting vector changes. This allows them to verify a distributive property and identify a pair of negative vectors.(a) Evaluate $\vec{a}-\vec{b}$.(b) Calculate $3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})$.(c) Evaluate $3\vec{a}-3\vec{b}$ and compare it with the result in part (b).(d) Determine $3(\vec{b}-\vec{a})$ and establish its relationship with $3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})$.
explanation: (a)`\vec{a}-\vec{b}=(1-2)\hat{i}+(-2-1)\hat{j}+[3-(-1)]\hat{k}\vec{a}-\vec{b}=-\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+4\hat{k}`(b)`3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})=3(-\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+4\hat{k})3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})=-3\hat{i}-9\hat{j}+12\hat{k}`(c)`3\vec{a}=3\hat{i}-6\hat{j}+9\hat{k}`and`3\vec{b}=6\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-3\hat{k}`Therefore,`3\vec{a}-3\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}-9\hat{j}+12\hat{k}`Hence,`3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})=3\vec{a}-3\vec{b}`The distributive property is verified.(d)`\vec{b}-\vec{a}=\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-4\hat{k}`Therefore,`3(\vec{b}-\vec{a})=3\hat{i}+9\hat{j}-12\hat{k}`Thus,`3(\vec{b}-\vec{a})=-3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})`The two resulting vectors have equal magnitudes and opposite directions.

options.B:
(a) $\vec{a}-\vec{b}=\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$
(b) $3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})=3\hat{i}-9\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$
(c) $3\vec{a}-3\vec{b}=3\hat{i}-9\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$
(d) The two resulting vectors are equal
options.D:
(a) $\vec{a}-\vec{b}=-\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$
(b) $3(\vec{a}-\vec{b})=-3\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$
(c) The distributive property fails
(d) The reversed difference has the same direction
